_doc: DEFAULT-PRELUDE AXIOM RATCHET. Censuses the environment a bare `clean check <file>` loads:
Environment::with_prelude() plus the checked CLI-side registrars init_monad_list_insts /
init_ulift (clean_elab::module_driver::module_environment, PreludeMode::Builtin). IO, control
and admission signatures are opt-in stub fragments; pure source requests none.
THE HOLE THIS CLOSES: data/soundness_tcb.json's 3-axiom trusted base is measured over
Environment::soundness_certificate_env(), which is Environment::new() plus the NN/math overlays
and NEVER calls with_prelude(); data/axiom_audit.json scopes total_domain_axioms = 0 to that same
soundness_tcb_mirror. Neither artifact moves by one when an axiom is added to the environment
users actually get, and CLAUDE.md's first soundness rule -- 'prove' means transitive closure
subset of FOUNDATIONAL_AXIOMS -- is measured against that environment everywhere else.
TAXONOMY IS NOT NEW: the buckets come from env::soundness_certificate::partition_axioms, the same
partition C2 of the Soundness Certificate uses. This surface adds exactly one split the
certificate does not need (its `other` bucket is empty): a non-foundational axiom is
debt_proposition when the kernel infers its declared type to be a Prop -- an asserted
mathematical statement, genuine domain-specific debt. A data-typed axiom (Sort u, u != 0) is
debt_signature ONLY when env/axiom_inhabitation.rs WITNESSES its type inhabited in one fixed
model of the whole environment (every uninterpreted type former read as the constant PUnit
family; the conclusion under whnf must be a Sort, a hypothesis's own type, an uninterpreted
type former, or an index-free inductive with a witnessed constructor) -- an uninterpreted
symbol such as Set.union or IO.println. A data-typed axiom with NO witness is
debt_inhabitation: its type claims an inhabitant the census cannot exhibit, and it is
treated exactly like an asserted proposition. THE SORT ALONE DECIDES NOTHING: until
2026-09-28 `Pure.pure : {m} -> {a} -> a -> m a` sat in debt_signature ('asserts no
proposition') and proved False at m := fun _ => Empty
(docs/issues/2026-09-28-prelude-pure-proves-false.md). unknown_sort is the fail-honest
fourth bucket: a type the kernel could not classify is the absence of information and is
never folded into any debt count.
ENFORCEMENT: crates/clean-kernel/src/env/tests_prelude_axiom_ratchet.rs, three refusals plus an
anti-vacuity floor -- (1) a live non-foundational axiom name absent from the pinned lists,
(2) any baseline_* count rising, (3) the live foundational set growing beyond `foundational`
(widening FOUNDATIONAL_AXIOMS is the cheap way to green this gate and is refused), and (4) THE
LOAD-BEARING ONE, a Theorem-kind constant whose axiom_deps -- its non-foundational transitive
closure -- is non-empty and is not pinned in theorems_reaching_debt; and (5) a name pinned in
debt_signature that the witness criterion refuses (the Pure.pure misclassification, by name).
TO LEGITIMATELY UPDATE: preferred, discharge the axiom to a kernel-checked value; the counts fall
and nothing here needs editing. Otherwise regenerate with
CLEAN_PRELUDE_AXIOM_RATCHET_UPDATE=1 targo --unverified test --locked -p clean-kernel --lib -- prelude_axiom_ratchet
and justify the added name in review. Counts are flat-or-down; never raise a baseline to green a
build.
